setting: Offline recorded-event batch; all existing RGB frames encoded first; nested depth frame subsets chosen without consulting depth content or reference labels.
frame_order_rule: Start with temporal centre, then farthest temporal index; or start nearest RGB descriptor mean, then farthest RGB descriptor from selected set. Ties use original ordered row. These are experimental comparators, not invented algorithms.
cost: min(requested frames, available selected unique frames); all RGB work retained; no padding charged
base_models: Same frozen DINOv2 features and SVR hyperparameter grid as the previous full-depth baseline; 1/3/6-frame depth scorers selected on inner validation only; full-depth scorer reused exactly
benefit: Absolute RGB error minus action-specific RGBD error from leave-one-training-animal-out base fits; gate sees RGB only
allocation: Exact multiple-choice knapsack; one of zero/1/3/6/up-to-12 depth frames per event; action benefits need not increase with frame count
gate_selection: Mean inner validation routed MAE at .25/.5/.75 frame caps; KRR bandwidth multipliers .5/1/2; ridge penalties .01/.1/1/10/100
reference_integrity: No test label used by deployable frame ordering, benefit gate, or allocation. Oracle is explicitly diagnostic.
prior_outcomes: Source outer test outcomes were already observed during prior exploratory method search; do not label this confirmatory or an independent new test.
